title: noccaea fendleri subsp. glauca
intro: Noccaea fendleri subsp. glauca, commonly known as Rocky Mountain penny-cress, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of arthritis, improve cardiovascular health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Noccaea fendleri subsp. glauca include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as glucosinolates, isothiocyanates, and other sulfur-containing compounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant have also been shown to exhibit anti-diabetic, neuroprotective, and anti-aging effects, making it a promising candidate for further research into its potential health benefits.
